WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.a|K.text: Demonstrate understanding of the organization and basic features of print. a. Follow words from left to right, top to bottom, and page by page.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.a|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, demonstrate an understanding of the organization and basic features of print. a. With guidance and support during shared reading, turn pages one page at a time from beginning to end.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can explain why we read from left to right and top to bottom.
I can use my knowledge of print awareness to help me sound out words.
I can read simple sentences independently.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can consistently track words from left to right.
I can consistently track words from top to bottom.
I can consistently turn pages from left to right.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can consistently identify the front and back of a book.
I can consistently hold a book the correct way.
I can sometimes track words from left to right.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can sometimes identify the front and back of a book.
I can sometimes hold a book the correct way.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support during shared reading, turn pages one page at a time from beginning to end.
I can during shared reading, turn the page when the reader stops and gestures to guide the student to turn the page.
I can listen to books on tape that have an audible tone to indicate when the page should be turned.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, recognize that books are read one page at a time.
I can with guidance and support while listening to a book on tape, turn the page after an audible beep.
I can with guidance and support during shared reading, turn the page after the teacher separates the page.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, turn pages in a book.
I can with guidance and support while reading a book on the computer, turn pages by clicking the mouse or a switch.
I can with guidance and support during shared reading, turn pages but not necessarily front to back or one at a time.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.b|K.text: Recognize that spoken words are represented in written language by specific sequences of letters.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can match spoken words to written words and explain how each word is made up of a sequence of letters.
I can recognize and use letter patterns in written words to understand how spoken words are written.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can recognize that the words I say are made up of letters when I see them in writing.
I can point out that each spoken word matches a specific sequence of letters in written words.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can recognize that some spoken words are written with letters, but I need help to see how each word has its own sequence of letters.
I can match some spoken words to written words with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can with support recognize spoken words, but I need help to understand how words are written with letters.
I can with support match spoken words to written language.
descriptors.ee_at_target: N/A

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.c|K.text: Understand that words are separated by spaces in print.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can explain that words are separated by spaces in print and can point out where each word starts and ends in a sentence.
I can show how spaces between words help readers understand sentences more easily.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can recognize that words are separated by spaces in print and show where one word ends and the next begins.
I can use spaces when writing my own words to separate them clearly.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can recognize some spaces between words, but I need help to understand where each word starts and ends in a sentence.
I need reminders to use spaces between words when writing.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can with support find some words in print, but I need help to understand how spaces separate words in a sentence.
I can with support recognize and use spaces between words when reading or writing.
descriptors.ee_at_target: N/A

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.c|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.d|K.text: Recognize and name all upper- and lowercase letters of the alphabet.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can identify and name all uppercase and lowercase letters in different fonts and sizes.
 I can use my knowledge of letters to spell simple words.
 I can identify and name letters in my environment, such as on signs or in books.
 I can use my knowledge of letters to decode and write simple messages.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify all uppercase and lowercase letters.
 I can name all uppercase and lowercase letters.
 I can match uppercase and lowercase letters.
 I can recite the alphabet in order.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify most uppercase and lowercase letters.
 I can name most uppercase and lowercase letters.
 I can match uppercase and lowercase letters.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify some uppercase and lowercase letters.
 I can name some uppercase and lowercase letters.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, recognize one letter at a time in print.
I can Point to letters on the bulletin board and other locations in the classroom when asked, “Where do you see letters?”
I can with guidance and support, say the name of a letter from any word posted in the room (e.g., When an adult points out and names letters, words, and pictures on bulletin boards in the classroom and throughout the school, the student says any letter name when the adults points at letters).
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore letters in a variety of forms (e.g., keyboards, letter stamps, and magnetic letters).
I can with guidance and support from an adult who labels the letters and says words that start with the letter-sound, explore magnet letters on a cookie sheet.
I can with guidance and support from an adult who labels the letters and says words that start with the letter-sound, use a switch to select letters from an onscreen keyboard and listen as they are typed in a talking word processor.
I can with guidance and support, use alphabet software that is accessed by selecting letters on a keyboard.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.1.d|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.a|K.text: Demonstrate understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes). a. Recognize and produce rhyming words.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.a|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes). a. With guidance and support, recognize rhyming words.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can identify and explain the different types of rhymes (e.g., perfect rhyme, slant rhyme).
 I can use my understanding of phonemes to decode unfamiliar words.
 I can use my understanding of phonemes to create and perform original rap songs or poems.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify and produce rhyming words with accuracy.
 I can identify the individual sounds (phonemes) in spoken words.
 I can manipulate sounds (phonemes) to create new words.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can consistently identify rhyming words when they are spoken aloud.
 I can consistently produce rhyming words when prompted.
 I can begin to identify the individual sounds (phonemes) in spoken words.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can sometimes identify rhyming words when they are spoken aloud.
 I can sometimes produce rhyming words when prompted.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, recognize rhyming words.
I can Select a word from a choice of two that completes the rhyming pattern in a familiar, predictable book.
I can play a memory game by matching rhyming picture cards.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, provide a rhyming word to complete a repeated line in a familiar text.
I can with guidance and support, provide a rhyming word that completes a repeated line in a familiar text such as, “I do not like green eggs and ham.
 I do not like them, Sam I ____.”).
I can with guidance and support, select a picture that represents a rhyming word that completes the repeated line in a class-made book.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support during shared reading, provide a repeated line in a familiar, rhyming text.
I can with guidance and support, use a single message voice output device to provide a repeated line.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.b|K.text: Count, pronounce, blend, and segment syllables in spoken words.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.b|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes). b. With guidance and support, recognize the number of words in a spoken message.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can identify words with four or more syllables.
 I can clap or tap out the syllables in words with four or more syllables.
 I can blend four or more sounds together to make a word.
 I can break three-syllable words into their individual sounds.
 I can use my understanding of syllables to decode unfamiliar words.
 I can use my understanding of syllables to create new words.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify words with one, two, or three syllables.
 I can clap or tap out the syllables in words with one, two, or three syllables.
 I can blend two or three sounds together to make a word.
 I can break one- or two-syllable words into their individual sounds.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can consistently identify words with one or two syllables.
 I can consistently clap or tap out the syllables in words with one or two syllables.
 I can sometimes blend two sounds together to make a word.
 I can sometimes break a one-syllable word into its individual sounds.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can sometimes identify words with one syllable.
 I can sometimes clap or tap out the syllables in a word.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, recognize the number of words in a spoken message.
I can clap once for each word in a message spoken by an adult with exaggerated pauses between words.
I can clap once for each word in a written message that an adult reads while pointing in an exaggerated way to each word.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, recognize the number of words in a short spoken message presented with exaggerated pauses.
I can with guidance and support, clap once for each word in a message spoken by an adult who claps once for each word and then pauses to wait for the student to clap before moving on.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, participate in clapping along with stories, songs, and poems.
I can clap during a group clapping activity (e.g., While the class sings the morning welcome song and peers clap once for each word, the student randomly claps along.).
I can Tap along with the group (e.g., While the teacher reads a short poem, peers clap once for each word and the student taps along on his wheelchair tray.).

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.c|K.text: Blend and segment onsets and rimes [sic] of single-syllable spoken words.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.c|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes). c. With guidance and support, identify syllables in spoken words.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can manipulate sounds in spoken words (e.g., change the first sound, change the ending sound).
I can use my knowledge of onsets and rimes to decode and spell unfamiliar words.
I can apply my understanding of onsets and rimes to wordplay and creative writing activities.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can consistently break a spoken word into its two parts (onset and rime).
I can blend two sounds to make a spoken word.
I can segment a spoken word into its individual sounds.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can consistently identify the first sound in a spoken word.
I can consistently identify the rhyming word in a pair of spoken words.
I can sometimes break a spoken word into its two parts (onset and rime).
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can sometimes identify the first sound in a spoken word.
I can sometimes identify the rhyming word in a pair of spoken words.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, identify single-syllable spoken words with the same onset (beginning sound) as a familiar word.
I can with guidance and support during shared reading of a book with alliteration (e.g., Gotta Go! Gotta Go!), identify the word that begins with the same sound as a familiar word highlighted by the teacher.
I can with guidance and support in completing a picture-based sorting activity on an interactive whiteboard, identify the pictures that represent words that start with the same onset as the target word.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, recognize two letter-sounds that are the same.
I can Recognize if two beginning sounds are the same or different when the teacher isolates the first sound of a target word and a second word.
I can with guidance and support completing an activity on an interactive whiteboard, recognize two sounds that are the same.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, participate in shared reading and singing of stories, songs, tongue twisters, and poems with alliteration.
I can with guidance and support, use a sequenced message communication device to recite a poem that has alliteration with peers.
I can with guidance and support, fill in the last word of a familiar song being sung by peers.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.c|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can blend and break apart onsets and rimes in new words and make new rhyming words by changing the onset.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can blend and segment the onset and rime of single-syllable spoken words (c-at, cat).
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can blend an onset and rime when an adult says them slowly (m-op) with support.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can say the first sound of a spoken word with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can, with support, identify the syllables in spoken words by clapping or tapping.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.c|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.d|K.text: Isolate and pronounce the initial, medial vowel, and final sounds (phonemes) in three-phoneme (consonant-vowel-consonant, or CVC) words.[1] (This does not include CVCs ending with /l/, /r/, or /x/.)
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.d|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes). d. With guidance and support, identify single syllable spoken words with the same onset (beginning sound) as a familiar word.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can identify and manipulate phonemes in CVC words.
I can use my knowledge of phonemes to decode and spell new words.
I can apply my understanding of phonemes to read and write fluently.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify the first, middle, and last sounds (phonemes) in three-phoneme (CVC) words.
I can pronounce the initial, medial vowel, and final sounds in CVC words.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify the first and last sounds in most CVC words.
I can sometimes identify the middle sound in CVC words.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify the first sound in some CVC words.
I can sometimes identify the middle sound in CVC words.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify single syllable spoken words with the same onset (beginning sound) as a familiar word, with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify some single syllable spoken words with the same onset (beginning sound) as a familiar word, with guidance and support.
I can identify single syllable spoken words with the same onset as a familiar word, with significant support and repetition.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I am beginning to explore identifying single syllable spoken words with the same onset (beginning sound) as a familiar word, with guidance and support.
I can identify single syllable spoken words with the same onset as a familiar word, with extensive support and prompting.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.d|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.e|K.text: Add or substitute individual sounds (phonemes) in simple, one-syllable words to make new words.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.e|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of spoken words, syllables, and sounds (phonemes). e. With guidance and support, recognize the number of sounds in three-phoneme (consonant-vowel-consonant, or CVC) words

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can manipulate individual sounds in multi-syllabic words.
I can create new words by adding or substituting sounds.
I can use my knowledge of sounds to decode unfamiliar words.
I can apply my understanding of sounds to improve my spelling and writing.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify and manipulate individual sounds (phonemes) in simple, one-syllable words.
I can add or substitute individual sounds to make new words.
I can blend sounds to read simple words.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify the beginning and ending sounds in simple words.
I can consistently change the beginning sound of a word to make a new word.
I can sometimes change the middle sound of a word to make a new word.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify the beginning sounds in simple words.
I can sometimes change the beginning sound of a word to make a new word.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify the number of sounds (phonemes) in three-phoneme (CVC) words with guidance and support.
I can count the individual sounds in CVC words, such as "cat" (3 sounds), "dog" (3 sounds), or "sun" (3 sounds).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify the number of sounds in some three-phoneme words with guidance and support.
I can count the individual sounds in some CVC words, but may need additional support or prompting for longer words or those with less familiar sounds.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I am beginning to identify the number of sounds in some three-phoneme words with significant guidance and support.
I can identify the number of syllables in some CVC words, but may need help distinguishing individual sounds.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.2.e|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.a|K.text: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words. a. Demonstrate basic knowledge of letter-sound correspondences by producing the primary or most frequent sound for each consonant.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.a|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging awareness of print. a. With guidance and support, recognize first letter of own name in print.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can sound out multisyllabic words.
I can apply my knowledge of letter-sound correspondences to decode unfamiliar words.
I can use my decoding skills to read simple texts independently.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify all letters and their most common sounds.
I can sound out most one-syllable words.
I can identify the first and last sounds in most words.
I can identify the middle sound in some words.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify most letters and their most common sounds.
I can sound out simple words with minimal support.
I can identify the first sound in most words.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify some letters and their most common sounds.
I can attempt to sound out simple words with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, recognize sound of first letter in own name.
I can Recognize first sound of own name (e.g., When lining up students to leave the classroom, teacher calls the students by saying, “Line up if your name begins with /letter/ sound.” and the students recognize the sound for their own name).
I can Indicate self when first sound of own name is made (e.g., During shared writing, the teacher stops to stretch out the sounds in a word and asks, “Whose name starts like <sound>?” The student replies by indicating self.).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, recognize own name across contexts.
I can Answer when called on by name.
I can During shared reading of a class book, the student recognizes own name when the teacher reads it.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, recognize own name when called in a familiar routine.
I can with guidance and support during morning meeting, recognize own name when the teacher calls attendance.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.b|K.text: Associate the long and short sounds with the common spellings (graphemes) for the five major vowels.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use my knowledge of vowel sounds and spellings to decode unfamiliar words.
I can spell simple words with correct vowel sounds.
I can apply my understanding of vowel sounds and spellings to improve my reading fluency and comprehension.
I can identify and use different vowel sounds to change the meaning of words (e.g., bat vs. bet).
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can consistently identify the long and short sounds of the five major vowels when spoken.
I can accurately match spoken vowel sounds to their corresponding letters.
I can identify and use the common spellings (graphemes) for the five major vowels in writing and reading
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify the long and short sounds of the five major vowels when spoken.
I can match spoken vowel sounds to their corresponding letters with some accuracy.
I can identify some common spellings (graphemes) for the five major vowels
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify the five major vowels (a, e, i, o, u) when spoken.
I can sometimes match spoken vowel sounds to their corresponding letters
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.c|K.text: Read common high-frequency words by sight (e.g., the, of, to, you, she, my, is, are, do, does).
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.c|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging awareness of print. c. With guidance and support, recognize environmental print.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can read all common high-frequency words by sight, including irregular words and those with multiple meanings.
 I can use these words to read complex texts with fluency and comprehension.
 I can apply my knowledge of high-frequency words to decode unfamiliar words and improve my reading fluency.
 I can use high-frequency words in my own writing and speaking to communicate effectively.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can read most common high-frequency words by sight, automatically and effortlessly.
 I can use these words to read simple sentences and short texts with fluency and accuracy.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can recognize most high-frequency words with support, such as matching them to pictures or reading them aloud with help.
 I can identify many high-frequency words by sight, especially those I encounter frequently in books and everyday life.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can recognize some high-frequency words with support, such as pointing to them in a book when the teacher says the word.
 I can sometimes identify a few high-frequency words by sight, especially if they are repeated often.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, recognize common signs and/or symbols in the environment.
I can When shown an exit sign at one end of the hallway, find the exit sign at the other end.
I can When symbols are used regularly to support a visual schedule, identify one or more of the symbols.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support,use familiar symbols in simple communication exchanges.
I can with guidance and support, hand the teacher a symbol to communicate a choice during center time.
I can with modeling from the teacher or peers, place a symbol reflecting home next to the name of a peer who is out sick.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, interact with or explore symbols and objects in the environment.
I can Look at symbols when directed (e.g., When the teacher stops to point out a sign on the wall for the girls’ room, the student follows the teacher’s point and looks at the symbol.).
I can Explore objects when introduced (e.g., When the teacher is introducing objects that are being added to a classroom learning center, the student explores the objects.).

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.c|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.d|K.text: Distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying the sounds of the letters that differ.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can identify the individual sounds in any word and use this knowledge to decode unfamiliar words. I can also explain how the sounds of letters change depending on their position in a word. For example, I know that the "c" in "cat" makes a different sound than the "c" in "city."
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can identify the individual sounds in most words and distinguish between similarly spelled words by identifying the sounds of the letters that differ. For example, I can tell the difference between "cat" and "hat" by identifying the different sounds of the first letter.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can identify the first sound in most words and sometimes identify the last sound. I can sometimes tell when two words start with the same sound.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can sometimes identify the first sound in a word
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.3.d|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.4|K.text: Read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding.
WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.4|K.ee_text: Engage in purposeful shared reading of familiar text.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can read emergent-reader texts independently and with fluency.
 I can make connections between the text and my own life experiences.
 I can use emergent-reader texts to learn new information and vocabulary.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding.
 I can identify the main characters and events in an emergent-reader text.
 I can retell the story of an emergent-reader text in my own words.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can track the words as someone reads an emergent-reader text to me.
 I can answer simple questions about the main idea of an emergent-reader text.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify familiar objects and pictures in emergent-reader texts.
 I can attempt to follow along as someone reads an emergent-reader text to me.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can, engage in independent exploration of books.
I can select a book, open it, and silently study one or more pages.
I can while browsing books in the media center, select a book and explore it independently, turning a few pages at a time.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, engage in directed exploration of books.
I can with guidance and assistance, examine a book selected by an adult because the topic is one known to be of interest to the student.
I can Working with a reading partner, look at pages in the book, pointing and interacting about pictures in the book.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore books.
I can with guidance and support, explore pictures in a book (e.g., Working with an adult who provides encouragement and seeks pictures likely to be of interest to the student, the student visually explores one or more pictures in a book).
I can with guidance and support, explore pages in an electronic book (e.g., Working with a peer who directs the student’s attention and encourages switch use, the student uses a switch to step through pages in an electronic storybook.).

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.4|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can read emergent-reader books on my own and tell what happened and why I read them.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can read emergent-reader texts with purpose and understanding.
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can read along with an adult and point to words I know in a simple book.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can look at pictures and tell what a simple book is about with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can take part in shared reading of a familiar text for a purpose, such as finding a favourite page.

WI-CC-ELA|RF.K.4|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.1|K.text: With prompting and support, develop and answer questions about a text. (RI&RL)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.1|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, identify details in familiar texts.(RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can listen to a text read aloud and identify three or more key details without prompting.
I can ask three or more questions about a text without prompting.
I can use my understanding of the text to answer questions about the author's purpose, characters' feelings, or the main idea.
I can use my understanding of the text to make predictions about what might happen next.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can listen to a text read aloud and identify three or more key details with prompting and support.
I can ask three or more questions about a text with prompting and support.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can listen to a text read aloud and identify two or three key details with prompting and support.
I can ask two or three simple questions about a text with prompting and support.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to a text read aloud and identify one or two key details with prompting and support.
I can ask one simple question about a text with prompting and support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, identify a detail in a familiar text.
I can with guidance and support, identify a detail in a text from a field of choices.
I can with guidance and support, stop a reader or otherwise signal when a particular detail is read.
I can with guidance and support, find the place in a familiar book where a particular detail is presented.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, identify a detail in a familiar text about a personally relevant event or daily routine.
I can with guidance and support, identify a detail from a social story written to help him learn what to expect and how to behave in a frequently occurring situation.
I can with guidance and support, identify a detail in a Best Part of Me text written by the class.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, interact with or explore pictures or objects related to a text while it is read.
I can with guidance and support, interact with the milk cartons, dirt, seeds, and spoons that are required to plant the seeds as described in the chart being read with the group.
I can with guidance and support, visually explore the illustrations in a text about a favored topic (animal, train, etc.).

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.1|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.2|K.text: With prompting and support, retell stories (RL); share key details from a text. (RI)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.2|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, identify major events (RL) or the topic in a familiar text (RI).

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can retell stories independently, elaborating on key details and using expressive language.
I can identify and explain the main idea and key details from a text without prompting.
I can use information from a text to answer questions and make predictions about what might happen next.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can retell stories, including key details, with prompting and support.
I can share key details from a text with prompting and support.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can retell a familiar story with some prompting and support.
I can share several key details from a text with some assistance.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can try to retell a story with significant prompting and support.
I can identify some key details from a text with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify major events in a read-aloud story with guidance and support.
I can identify the topic of a familiar informational text with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify some major events in a read-aloud story with guidance and support.
I can identify the main topic of a familiar informational text with significant support.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify a few major events in a read-aloud story with significant support.
I can identify the topic of a familiar informational text with extensive support.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.2|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.3|K.text: With prompting and support, identify characters, settings, and important events in a story or pieces of information in a text. (RI&RL)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.3|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, identify characters and settings (RL) or important details and events (RI) in familiar texts.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently identify characters, settings, and important events in a story or informational text.
I can explain how characters, settings, and events contribute to the overall meaning of a story or text.
I can compare and contrast characters, settings, and events across different stories or texts.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify characters, settings, and important events in a story or informational text with prompting and support.
I can describe the characters, settings, and important events using simple sentences.
I can use pictures and other visual aids to identify characters, settings, and events.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify familiar characters with minimal prompting.
I can identify familiar settings with minimal prompting.
I can identify major events in a story with some support.
I can retell a simple story with prompting and support.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify familiar characters with direct prompting and support.
I can identify familiar settings with direct prompting and support.
I can identify a major event in a story with significant support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify characters and settings with guidance and support in familiar texts.
I can identify important details and events with guidance and support in familiar texts.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify characters and settings with some support in familiar texts.
I can identify important details and events with some support in familiar texts.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify characters and settings with significant support and repetition.
I can identify important details and events with significant support and repetition.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.3|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.4|K.text: With prompting and support, identify specific words that express feelings or content- specific words within a text. (RI&RL)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.4|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, indicate when an unknown word is used in a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can identify and analyze the use of specific words in a text, including how they contribute to the overall meaning and tone.I can use this understanding to make predictions about the text and discuss the author's purpose in using certain words.I can also use this skill to choose my own words carefully when writing and speaking.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can identify specific words that express feelings or content-specific words within a text, even without prompting.I can explain the meaning of these words in my own words and use them in my own writing and speaking.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can identify specific words in a text with prompting and support, including words that express feelings or content-specific vocabulary.I can sometimes explain the meaning of these words in my own words.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can identify some words in a text with significant prompting and support, but I may not always understand their meaning or purpose.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify and point out unknown words in a text with guidance and support.
I can ask questions about the meaning of unknown words in a text with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify some unknown words in a text with significant guidance and support.
I can attempt to identify unknown words based on pictures or context clues with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can notice when I don't understand a word in a text.
I can ask for help with understanding unknown words in a text.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.4|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.5|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, recognize familiar texts (e.g., storybooks, poems, informational texts) and locate the front cover of the book. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can identify a wide range of literary and informational texts, including complex texts.
I can explain the difference between literary and informational texts and how they are used.
I can identify and use features of informational texts to find information.
I can use my knowledge of literary and informational texts to discuss and analyze them.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify a variety of literary and informational texts.
I can explain the difference between pictures and words.
I can identify features of informational texts, such as headings, pictures, and captions.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify most familiar books and other texts.
I can usually tell the difference between pictures and words.
I can identify some features of informational texts, such as headings and pictures.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify some familiar books and other texts.
I can sometimes tell the difference between pictures and words.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can recognize familiar texts (e.g., storybooks, poems, informational texts) with guidance and support.
I can locate the front cover of a familiar text independently.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can independently recognize familiar texts (e.g., storybooks, poems).
I can locate the front cover of a familiar text with minimal support.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify familiar texts with significant support (e.g., picture cues, teacher prompts).
I can locate the front cover of a familiar text with assistance.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.5|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.6|K.text: Define the role of the author and the illustrator in presenting the ideas in a text. (RI&RL)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.6|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, distinguish between words and illustrations/graphics in a text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can analyze how the author and illustrator use different techniques to convey meaning (e.g., author uses figurative language, illustrator uses symbolism).
I can compare and contrast the roles of the author and illustrator in different texts.
I can create my own text and illustrations that work together to communicate a message.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can explain that the author and illustrator work together to present the ideas in a text.
I can identify specific ways the author and illustrator contribute to the meaning of the text (e.g., author uses descriptive language, illustrator uses color to create mood).
I can explain how the author and illustrator's choices impact the reader's understanding of the text.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can explain that the author chooses the words and ideas in a text.
I can explain that the illustrator creates pictures that match the story.
I can identify specific ways the illustrator helps to tell the story (e.g., facial expressions, setting details).
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify the author and illustrator of a text.
I can say that the author writes the words and the illustrator draws the pictures.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify words and illustrations/graphics in a text with minimal guidance and support.
I can explain the difference between words and illustrations/graphics, even when they are presented together.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify words and illustrations/graphics in a text with some guidance and support.
I can begin to explain the difference between words and illustrations/graphics, especially when they are presented separately.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify words and illustrations/graphics in a text with significant guidance and support.
I am starting to understand the difference between words and illustrations/graphics, but I may still need help distinguishing them.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.6|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.7|K.text: With prompting and support, describe the relationship between illustrations and the text. (RI&RL)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.7|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, identify illustrations or objects/tactile information that go with the text. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can explain how a picture helps me understand the characters and setting in a story.
I can compare and contrast the information in a picture with the information in the text.
I can use pictures to retell a story in my own words.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
With prompting and support, I can describe how a picture helps me understand the text.
I can explain how a picture shows what is happening in the story.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can say how a picture helps me understand the story.
I can describe one or two things that are happening in a picture.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify pictures in a book.
I can say what I see in a picture.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can independently identify illustrations, objects, or tactile information that directly relate to the text with 80% accuracy.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can identify illustrations, objects, or tactile information that directly relate to the text with some support (e.g., prompts, cues) with 60% accuracy.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I can identify illustrations, objects, or tactile information that directly relate to the text with significant support (e.g., modeling, repetition) with 40% accuracy.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.7|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.8|K.text: With prompting and support, identify specific information to support ideas in a text. (RI)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.8|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, identify points the author makes in text. (RI)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can find specific information in a text to support my ideas and I can explain how the information helps my ideas.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can find specific information in a text with help from an adult.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can sometimes find information in a text with help from an adult.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can try to find information in a text with help from an adult.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify points the author makes in text with guidance and support.
I can use pictures, diagrams, or other visuals to help me understand the points the author makes.
I can retell the main points of a story or informational text in my own words.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify some of the points the author makes in text with guidance and support.
I can use pictures, diagrams, or other visuals to help me understand some of the points the author makes.
I can retell some of the main points of a story or informational text in my own words.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify some of the points the author makes in text with significant support.
I can use pictures, diagrams, or other visuals to help me understand some of the points the author makes with significant support.
I can retell some of the main points of a story or informational text in my own words with significant support.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.8|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.9|K.text: With prompting and support, compare and contrast two texts; recognize that texts reflect one’s own and others’ culture. (RI&RL)
WI-CC-ELA|R.K.9|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, match similar parts of two familiar texts, identifying the adventures or experiences of a character. (RI&RL)

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently compare and contrast two texts, identifying multiple similarities and differences across various elements such as main ideas, characters, settings, events, and language.
I can explain how details from a text reflect the author's culture and my own culture, and I can discuss how these cultural influences shape the story or information presented.
I can use evidence from the texts to support my comparisons and contrasts and my understanding of cultural influences.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can listen to two texts read aloud and compare and contrast their main ideas, characters, settings, or events with prompting and support.
I can recognize that texts reflect the cultures of the people who wrote them and identify details from a text that relate to the author's culture and my own culture.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud and identify two similarities and one difference between them.
I can identify two details from a text that relate to my own culture and one detail that relates to another culture.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud with support and identify one similarity between them.
I can identify one detail from a text that relates to my own culture with support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can listen to two familiar texts read aloud and identify when the same character appears in both, even if the character has a different name or appearance.
I can explain how the character's adventures or experiences are similar in both texts, using simple sentences.
I can match pictures or objects that represent the character's adventures or experiences in each text, and explain how they are similar.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud and identify when the same character appears in both, even if the character has a different name.
I can, with some support, explain how the character's adventures or experiences are similar in both texts.
I can match simple pictures or objects that represent the character's adventures or experiences in each text.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can listen to two short texts read aloud and identify when the same character appears in both.
I can, with support, point to pictures or objects that represent the character's adventures or experiences in each text.

WI-CC-ELA|R.K.9|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.1|K.text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose reflective, formal, and creative writing, which may happen simultaneously or independently, for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.1|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low- stakes purposes.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use drawing, dictation, and writing creatively and effectively to express myself in different ways.
 I can adapt my writing style and content to different audiences and purposes.
 I can use my writing to reflect on my own learning and growth.
 I can use my writing to make a positive impact on my community or the world.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use drawing, dictation, and writing independently or together to create different types of writing (reflective, formal, creative).
 I can write complete sentences with correct spelling and punctuation most of the time.
 I can use my writing to communicate effectively for different purposes (high-stakes and low-stakes).
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can combine drawing and dictation to create short stories or descriptions.
 I can write simple sentences with some correct spelling and punctuation.
 I can use drawing or writing to reflect on my experiences or feelings.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use drawing or dictation to share simple stories or ideas.
 I can sometimes write individual letters or words to represent my thoughts.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use drawing, dictating, or writing to compose writing for a variety of high-stakes and low-stakes purposes, with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can use drawing, dictating, or writing to communicate basic information for simple purposes, with some guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I can use drawing, dictating, or writing to express myself in simple ways, with significant guidance and support.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.1|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.a|K.text: Use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose text in a variety of modes. a. Opinion pieces in which they tell the reader the topic or the name of the book they are writing about and state an opinion or preference about the topic or book.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.a|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, use writing, dictation and/or drawing to compose: a. Opinion pieces in which they state an opinion.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can write opinion pieces with strong arguments and supporting evidence.
 I can write informative or explanatory texts using clear organization and details.
 I can write narratives with vivid descriptions and engaging characters.
 I can use my writing to communicate effectively with others in different contexts.
 I can write for different audiences and purposes.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can write opinion pieces stating my opinion or preference about a topic or book.
 I can write informative or explanatory texts providing information about a topic.
 I can write narratives telling about real or imagined events in order.
 I can use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to create different types of texts.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can draw pictures and use words to tell a story or event.
 I can dictate sentences and short paragraphs to an adult to help me write.
 I can write simple sentences with correct letter formation and spacing.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can draw pictures to represent a story or event.
 I can dictate simple sentences to an adult to help me write.
 I can copy letters and words with some guidance.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, select a topic and use drawing, dictating, or writing to share information about the topic.
I can after choosing to write about self, looking at a picture of himself, and talking with a teacher about his features (hair, face, hands) and clothes, use drawing, dictating, writing, assistive technology, or other means of expression to state information about himself.
I can after selecting a picture of himself, looking at it, and interacting with a teacher using a multiple message voice output device with body part labels (the teacher is modeling the device and talking about the messages), use the device to dictate a list of his body parts.
I can In structured shared writing during which the teacher uses a repeated sentence frame to guide students in creating a predictable chart with a repeated line (e.g., I like____), select a topic (e.g., hot dogs) and dictate a response (e.g., “hotdogs”) for the teacher to add to the chart.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, select a topic for use in shared writing.
I can during a shared writing activity, when the teacher presents two symbols or objects that could be used to complete a sentence, select one.
I can during journaling time, when the teacher presents three photos of familiar activities or experiences, select one as the topic, then use a(n adapted) keyboard to type letters in a title space and type additional letters on the page, with which the teacher will, afterward, type, point to, and read aloud a short conventional title and three-word sample informational sentence.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, interact with objects and artifacts and produce emergent writings related to the topics that other students are writing about.
I can during a shared writing activity, interact with objects while a peer shares his/her writing and then with objects removed, observe as a peer reads and points to his/her writing a second time (e.g., A peer shares his writing which includes a picture of a dinosaur and some beginning writing. The peer also shares some toy dinosaurs from a classroom collection and the student interacts with the toy dinosaurs. The toys are removed and the peer points to the picture of the dinosaur and then points to his writing as he reads it aloud a final time.).
I can during a shared writing activity, explore objects that peers are writing about (e.g., Peers are writing about leaves they collected on a walk outside. The student uses available senses to explore his/her own leaves.), and then use (adapted) writing tools and paper or a whiteboard to engage in emergent writing behaviors.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.a|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can draw, tell and write my opinion about a book or topic and give a reason.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can draw, tell and write to name a topic or book and state my opinion about it.
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can draw a picture and tell an adult what I like or do not like about a book.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture to show which book or thing I like with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can, with support, draw, dictate or write to state my opinion.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.b|K.text: Informative or explanatory text in which they name what they are writing about and supply some information about the topic.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.b|K.ee_text: Informative/Explanatory text in which they provide some information about a predetermined or self chosen topic.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can name what I am writing about and provide detailed information about the topic, using descriptive language to explain it fully.
I can organize my writing clearly, making sure that the information I provide helps the reader understand the topic.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can name what I am writing about and provide some information about the topic.
I can include a few details to help explain my topic to the reader.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can name what I am writing about, but I need help to provide information about the topic.
I can include a little information, but it may not explain the topic fully.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can name what I am writing about with help, but I need a lot of support to provide any information about the topic.
I need adult assistance to include details or information about the topic.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can write about a topic and include at least two facts or details.
I can provide information about my topic that others can understand.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can write about a topic but need help to include information.
I can share one fact or detail with support.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with support choose a topic but need help to provide information.
I can share one piece of information with help.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.c|K.text: Convey events, real or imagined and narrate a single event or several loosely linked events, tell about the events in the order in which they occurred, and provide a reaction to what happened.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.c|K.ee_text: Convey events, real or imagined and narrate a single event or several loosely linked events.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can write about real or imagined events, telling them in order, and include details to make the events clear and interesting.
I can explain my reaction to what happened and include more than one feeling or thought about the events.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can tell about one event or several events in the order they happened.
I can include my reaction to what happened in my story.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can tell about an event or several events, but I may need help keeping them in the right order.
I can give a basic reaction to what happened, but I need support to add more detail.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can tell about an event with support, but I need help putting the events in the right order.
I can with support describe how I felt or reacted to what happened.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can write about a real or imagined event and tell what happened in the correct order.
I can describe at least two events and link them together.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can write about an event, but I need help keeping the events in order.
I can describe one or two events with support.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with support tell about one event but need help organizing it.
I can with help share what happened in the event with some details.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.2.c|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)
