descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use drawing, dictation, and writing to tell a story with a clear beginning, middle, and end.
 I can use a variety of words to describe my drawings and stories, including words related to the topic and some more complex vocabulary.
 I can organize my story in a way that is creative and engaging for others.
 I can use my writing to share my ideas and experiences with others in a clear and organized way.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use drawing, dictation, and writing to tell a story with a clear beginning, middle, and end.
 I can use familiar words to describe my drawings and stories, including some words related to the topic.
 I can organize my story in a way that makes sense to others.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use drawing, dictation, and some writing to tell a story.
 I can use simple words to describe my drawings and stories, including some words related to the topic.
 I can sometimes organize my story by showing a beginning, middle, and end.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use drawing or dictation to tell a story.
 I can sometimes use simple words to describe my drawings or stories.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, select an event and use drawing, dictating, or writing to narrate information about it.
I can when given an array of photos from a class field trip, select one of the pictures, spend time talking about the event depicted in the picture with an adult or peer, and then label it verbally while the teacher writes the labels.
I can working with a teacher who is modeling how to select messages on a multiple message voice output device, select messages to dictate information about an experience during a learning center (e.g., make, big, house, kick, over, all done).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, select an event to write about during shared writing.
I can given three choices of events to write about, select one and then participate in shared writing about it.
I can given an array of photos depicting personal events, select a photo that the teacher uses as the topic for shared writing.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, choose a comment about an event or experience for an adult or peer to write down.
I can given a preprogrammed voice output communication device and encouragement to “tell us about the trip,” activate the device to say, “I had fun,” which the teacher will write down and then, while pointing word by word, read aloud.
I can shown symbols of good and great, select one of the two symbols to comment on an experience the teachers know the child enjoyed, and then select from an array of symbols with accompanying descriptive words ideas that accompany that judgment (e.g., hot, tired, thirsty, sleepy if they select bad).

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.3.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.3.b|K.text: Word Choice (including domain specific): Use words familiar to the student.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use a wide variety of familiar and domain-specific words that clearly describe what I am writing about.
I can choose words carefully to make my writing interesting and clear, even using new words I have learned recently.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use familiar words to talk about what I am writing, including some domain-specific words that are related to my topic.
I can use words that help my reader understand what I am writing about.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use some familiar words in my writing, but I need help to use domain-specific words related to the topic.
I can choose words to describe what I am writing about, but I may need support to make my word choices clearer.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use a few familiar words in my writing with support, but I need help to include more words or describe my topic clearly.
I can with support use domain-specific words or choose words that match what I am trying to say.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.3.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.4|K.text: With guidance and support from adults, use a combination of drawing, dictating, and writing to compose text in which the development and organization are culturally-sustaining and rhetorically authentic to task and purpose. (Grade-specific expectations for writing types are defined in standards 1-3 above.)

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can draw, tell and write a short piece for a clear purpose and explain who it is for.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can, with help from an adult, draw, tell and write to make a piece that fits my task and purpose.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can draw a picture and tell an adult about it to share an idea with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can make marks or choose a picture to share an idea with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: (Begins in grade 3)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.4|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.5|K.text: With guidance and support from adults, respond to questions and suggestions from peers and add details to strengthen writing as needed.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.5|K.ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, add more information to their own drawing, dictation, or writing to strengthen it.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently respond to questions and suggestions from peers and use their feedback to improve my writing.
 I can independently add details to my writing to make it more interesting and informative, even without adult support.
 I can use my writing to communicate effectively with others in different situations, such as writing a letter to a friend or creating a story for my classmates.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can respond to questions and suggestions from peers with guidance and support from adults.
 I can add details to my writing to strengthen it, with guidance and support from adults.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can respond to simple questions and suggestions from peers with some adult support.
 I can add some details to my writing with some help from adults.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can attempt to respond to questions and suggestions from peers with some adult support.
 I can try to add details to my writing, but I may need significant help from adults.
descriptors.ee_at_target: EE Emerging I can add one or two simple details to my drawing, dictation, or writing with help from an adult. I can repeat information from my drawing, dictation, or writing with prompting. EE Approaching I can add three or more details to my drawing, dictation, or writing with some help from an adult. I can retell information from my drawing, dictation, or writing in my own words with support. EE At Target I can add details to my drawing, dictation, or writing to make it more interesting and informative with guidance from an adult. I can retell information from my drawing, dictation, or writing in my own words with clear details.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.5|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.6|K.text: With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers. Learn to produce writing through printing (including forming most printed upper- and lower-case letters), cursive, or typing.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.6|K.ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce individual or group writing. With guidance and support from adults, produce writing through printing (including letter- like marks or forming some printed letters).

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently choose and use appropriate digital tools to write for different purposes.
 I can write and publish my work in a variety of formats, such as ebooks, blogs, and videos.
 I can use digital tools to share my writing with others and get feedback.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use a variety of digital tools to write, such as drawing, typing, and recording audio.
 I can print most uppercase and lowercase letters independently.
 I can collaborate with peers to write and publish our work using digital tools.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use some digital tools to write with adult support, such as drawing or typing simple words.
 I can print most uppercase and lowercase letters with some guidance.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can explore digital tools with adult support, but I need help understanding how to use them for writing.
 I can print some letters and words with guidance, but I still need help forming them correctly.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, explore a variety of digital tools to produce writing that is published.
I can work with an adult who models the use of the touchscreen on a computer or tablet device, touch the screen to select letters or words, and then upload the final product to an Internet-based, class publishing environment.
I can work with peers who model how to use drawing or painting software, use a variety of digital drawing and painting tools to produce writing, which is then printed and incorporated into a class book.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, explore a variety of digital tools and print products.
I can work with an adult who models the use of the touchscreen on a computer or tablet device, touch and visually attend to the screen then interact with the printed product.
I can work with peers who model how to use drawing or painting software, use a variety of digital drawing and painting tools to make marks.
I can explore word banks and an alphabet in multimedia writing software to produce a text, which is uploaded by the teacher to the class Internet-based publishing environment.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore various means of accessing digital tools, and print, save, and display the product in the class or on the Internet.
I can activate a switch to scan through the letters of the alphabet and have the product printed and saved in their writing folder.
I can touch, bang, or swipe over the surface of an alternative keyboard so the product can be printed and hung on the class writing bulletin board.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.6|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.7|K.text: Participate in shared inquiry and writing projects (e.g., explore a number of books by a favorite author and express opinions about them).
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.7|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, participate in shared inquiry and writing projects.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can lead shared inquiry and writing projects about books.
 I can ask thoughtful questions about books and engage in discussions with others.
 I can write creatively about books, using my imagination and knowledge.
 I can apply my understanding of books to real-life situations, such as recommending books to friends or writing book reviews.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can actively participate in shared inquiry and writing projects about books.
 I can ask and answer questions about books, sharing my own ideas and opinions.
 I can collaborate with others to write about books, following simple guidelines.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can ask and answer simple questions about books.
 I can share my own opinions and ideas about books with some support.
 I can participate in collaborative writing projects with guidance from adults.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to others share their ideas and opinions about books.
 I can participate in simple discussions about books with guidance from adults.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, participate in shared research and writing projects.
I can given a book on a topic related to a shared reading project and guidance in finding a page with pictures related to the research topic, identifying pictures that relate to the shared research and writing project.
I can given a pre-made software set-up with banks of words and pictures related to a shared research and writing project and, select words and pictures to contribute to the shared product.
I can select the topic of the research project and choose words or ideas to include pictures and word banks.
I can read and listen with a peer to talking books selected by the teacher in a digital reading environment and with a keyboard with alphabet and whole word access, type letters, words, or sentences about what they learn.
I can type letters as they are dictated by a peer and then dictate known letters to a peer to add content to a shared writing project.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, participate in selecting pictures and words to contribute to shared research and writing projects.
I can with guidance and support from the teacher, select from a bank of words and pictures on an interactive whiteboard to contribute to writing a shared research project.
I can with guidance and support from the teacher who has selected a website with words and pictures about the research project, point to pictures and words to contribute to writing the shared research project.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore pictures, words, or objects related to a shared research project.
I can, given a multimedia presentation of words and pictures related to a shared research project, use a switch to advance through the pictures looking and/or listening to the words and pictures, and select one which a peer, aide, or teacher will write in the shared research project.
I can use a touchscreen to scroll through pictures related to the topic of a shared research project and select one which a peer, aide, or teacher will write in the shared research project.
I can explore a bin full of objects and artifacts related to a shared research project, and select one which a peer, aide, or teacher will write in the shared research project.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.7|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.8|K.text: With guidance and support from adults, recall information from experiences or gather information from provided sources to answer a question.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.8|K.ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, identify information, objects, or events that relate to personal experiences.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can remember details from past experiences and use them to answer complex questions.
 I can independently gather information from multiple sources to answer questions and solve problems.
 I can use the information I have learned to make predictions about what might happen in the future.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can remember information from my own experiences and use it to answer questions.
 I can gather information from books or other sources to answer questions with guidance from adults.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can remember some things that happened to me before and tell others about them.
 I can listen to a story and answer simple questions about it without always needing help from adults.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can try to remember things that happened to me before, but I might need help from adults to remember details.
 I can listen to a story and answer simple questions about it with help from adults.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support from adults, identify information, objects, or events that relate to personal experiences.
I can with guidance and support, select an object to include in a shared writing activity (e.g., During a shared writing activity that requires students to identify one thing they do at home to complete a sentence, At home, I like to play _____, select a toy from an array of objects gathered by the teacher).
I can with guidance and support, select a picture to include in a shared writing activity (e.g., During a shared writing activity that involves completing a page for a class-made book, select a picture from an array of pictures of ice cream to illustrate her own page that says I like to eat ice cream).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support from adults during shared writing activities, select personal objects from an array of choices to be included in a text.
I can with guidance and support, select a color to fill in a blank in a sentence during a shared writing activity (e.g., select a color from a selection to fill in the blank in this sentence: I have a red backpack).
I can with guidance and support, put own name onto a project during a shared writing activity (e.g., select his art project from the rack and then attempt to write his name on it following a teacher model if needed).
I can Use a picture/label schedule to identify the next activity of the day.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support from adults during shared writing activities, interact with familiar objects that are being offered as choices in a text.
I can during a shared writing activity that requires children to identify the leaf they found and describe it to complete a sentence, interact with an assortment of leaves collected by the class to have their sentence and leaf (e.g., I like this leaf) added to a multimedia product.
I can during snack time, use a menu with two pictured and written choices to select a desired snack.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.8|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.9|K.text: With guidance and support from adults, recall facts from literary and informational text to research characters, setting, key detail, specified information, and ideas presented in a text.
WI-CC-ELA|W.K.9|K.ee_text: With guidance and support from adults, recall key details from literary or informational texts.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can remember important facts and details from a story or book, even without help from a grown-up.
 I can use the information I remember to answer questions about the story, talk about the characters and setting, and make predictions about what might happen next.
 I can use the information I remember from different stories and books to compare and contrast them.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can remember important facts from a story or book, with some help from a grown-up.
 I can remember the names of the main characters, where and when the story takes place, and some important details about the story.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can remember some important things I learned from a story or book, with help from a grown-up.
 I can usually remember the names of the main characters in a story and where the story takes place.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can try to remember some things I learned from a story or book, with help from a grown-up.
 I can sometimes remember the names of some characters in a story.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can, with guidance, recall key details from a story or informational text I have read or listened to.
I can share at least two important details from the text with support.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can, with some support, remember one key detail from a story or informational text.
I need help to recall more than one important detail from the text.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with support remember something from a story or text, but I need help to understand what details are important.
I can share one simple idea from the text with help.

WI-CC-ELA|W.K.9|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.a|K.text: With guidance and support, participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups. a. Follow agreed-upon norms and participate by actively listening, taking turns, and staying on topic.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.a|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, participate in conversations with others. a. Communicate directly with supportive adults or peers.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can participate in conversations independently and initiate discussions with peers and adults.
 I can actively listen to others, ask questions, and contribute to the conversation.
 I can take turns speaking and ensure everyone has a chance to participate.
 I can stay on topic and guide the conversation when needed.
 I can apply these conversation skills in real-life situations, such as group projects or discussions at home.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can participate in conversations with guidance and support and follow agreed-upon norms.
 I can listen to others attentively and stay focused.
 I can take turns speaking and wait for my turn patiently.
 I can stay on topic throughout the conversation.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can participate in conversations with some support and generally follow agreed-upon norms.
 I can listen to others for longer periods and am less easily distracted.
 I can take turns speaking and rarely interrupt others.
 I can stay on topic with some reminders.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can participate in conversations with some support, but I may not always follow agreed-upon norms.
 I can listen to others for short periods but may get distracted easily.
 I can take turns speaking but may interrupt others sometimes.
 I can stay on topic with some support.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can communicate directly with peers.
I can communicate directly with a peer when addressed.
I can greet your neighbor.
I can tell a peer what his or her favorite animal is when asked.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support from an adult, participate in communication exchanges with peers.
I can ask what a peer brought for lunch as instructed by the teacher (e.g., The teacher instructs the student to ask classmates if they are buying a school lunch today).
I can respond to a peer’s question about a favorite animal as instructed by the teacher.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support of an adult, share information with a peer.
I can repeat information stated by the teacher to a peer (e.g., Teacher says, “We went to lunch. Jim, tell Perry where we went.” Students respond, “lunch.”).

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.b|K.text: Participate in a conversation through multiple exchanges.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.b|K.ee_text: Participate in multiple-turn communication exchanges with support from adults.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can initiate and participate in conversations with others, even if they are unfamiliar.
 I can use a variety of language features, such as humor, figurative language, and complex sentence structures, to enhance my communication.
 I can adjust my communication style to fit the situation and audience.
 I can use my conversations to build relationships and learn new things.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can participate in a conversation with multiple exchanges, taking turns speaking and listening.
 I can ask and answer questions, share information, and express my opinions.
 I can use appropriate language and stay on topic.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can take turns speaking and listening in a conversation with two or more people.
 I can ask and answer simple questions using complete sentences.
 I can stay on topic during a conversation.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can take turns speaking and listening in a conversation with one other person.
 I can respond to simple questions with one or two words.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can participate in multiple-turn communication exchanges with adults.
I can Listen when the teacher speaks and communicate responses when addressed by the teacher.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can communicate directly with an adult.
I can answer a Yes/No question from an adult.
I can make a choice when presented with two or more options.
I can Initiate a greeting when the teacher enters the room.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, communicate directly with an adult.
I can use gestures, vocalizations, or make eye contact with an adult to communicate a reaction or need.
I can call an adult’s name to gain his/her attention.
I can respond to greetings and farewells initiated by an adult.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.c|K.text: Ask questions about the topic or text.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.c|K.ee_text: Respond to questions about the topic or text.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can ask open-ended questions that require critical thinking.
 I can ask questions to analyze a text or situation.
 I can ask questions to generate new ideas or solutions.
 I can use my questions to lead a discussion or debate.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can ask focused questions about a specific part of a picture or story.
 I can ask questions to learn more about a topic.
 I can ask questions to compare and contrast different things.
 I can ask questions to solve a problem.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can ask multiple questions about a picture or story.
 I can ask questions about a familiar topic using who, what, where, and why.
 I can ask questions to clarify my understanding of a topic.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can ask one question about a picture or story.
 I can ask simple questions about a familiar topic.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can answer simple questions about the topic or text using complete sentences.
I can use context clues from the text to answer questions.
I can identify the main idea of the text and answer questions related to it.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can answer simple questions about the topic or text using single words or short phrases.
I can identify some details from the text and answer questions about them.
I can retell the story or event in my own words.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can answer simple questions about the topic or text by pointing or nodding.
I can identify some pictures or objects in the text.
I can listen to the story or event and participate in simple activities related to it.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.c|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.d|K.text: Consider individual differences when communicating with others.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.d|K.ee_text: Consider individual differences when communicating with others.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can actively seek out information about different cultures and perspectives.
 I can use my understanding of individual differences to build strong relationships with people from diverse backgrounds.
 I can advocate for inclusive communication practices that value and respect all individuals.
 I can use my communication skills to promote understanding and cooperation between people with different backgrounds and perspectives.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can consider individual differences when communicating with others, such as their age, gender, personality, abilities, and cultural backgrounds.
 I can adjust my communication style to effectively communicate with different people.
 I can use different communication strategies to ensure understanding and respect individual needs and preferences.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify several different ways that people are different, such as personality, abilities, and cultural backgrounds.
 I can adjust my communication style to better understand and be understood by others who are different from me.
 I can ask questions to learn more about someone's individual needs and preferences.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify basic differences between people, such as age or gender.
 I can use simple language to communicate with others, even if they are different from me.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can adjust my communication style based on the person I am talking to, such as using simpler language with younger children or speaking more slowly with someone who has difficulty understanding.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify some individual differences that might affect how someone understands me, such as age or disability.
I can sometimes adjust my communication style based on the person I am talking to, but I need reminders or support to do this consistently.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I am aware that people are different and may have different needs.
I am starting to learn about how individual differences can affect communication.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.1.d|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.2|K.text: With guidance and support, ask and answer questions about key details in a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.2|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, demonstrate an emerging understanding of a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by answering questions

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can listen to a text or presentation and identify key details independently.
I can ask and answer complex questions about key details in a text or presentation independently.
I can use the information I learn from texts and presentations to answer questions about my own life and experiences.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can listen to a text or presentation and identify key details with guidance and support from an adult.
I can ask and answer questions about key details in a text or presentation with guidance and support from an adult.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can listen to a text or presentation and identify several key details with support from an adult.
I can ask and answer simple questions about a text or presentation with some help from an adult
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can listen to a short text or presentation and identify one or two key details with support from an adult.
I can ask simple questions about a text or presentation with help from an adult
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can demonstrate anEE Emerging understanding of a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by answering questions.
I can answer yes/no questions about details presented in a story read aloud to them.
I can answer a question about a detail presented in a story read aloud to them (through gestures, vocalizations, eye contact or gaze).
I can, after lunch menu is read, the student answers question about what the lunch will be for the day.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, demonstrate anEE Emerging understanding of a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by answering questions.
I can after listening to a weather report, answer questions about the day’s weather by selecting from two symbols.
I can after listening to a story, choose symbols (e.g., yes, no, maybe) in response to the question “Did you like the story?”
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can attend to a familiar text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.
I can watch a segment of Planet Earth during a science lesson.
I can attend to speaker at school assembly.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.2|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.3|K.text: Ask and answer questions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can ask and answer complex questions about a variety of topics.
I can use sophisticated vocabulary and sentence structures when asking and answering questions.
I can ask and answer questions to further my understanding of a topic.
I can use questioning strategies to engage in discussions and debates.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can ask and answer questions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify something that is not understood.
 I can ask questions using complete sentences and appropriate grammar.
 I can answer questions using complete sentences, providing relevant and accurate information.
 I can ask and answer questions about a variety of topics, including unfamiliar ones.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can ask questions using complete sentences, but may need support to formulate questions clearly.
 I can answer questions using complete sentences, but may need support to provide complete or relevant information.
 I can ask and answer questions about familiar topics.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can ask simple questions using single words or short phrases.
 I can answer simple questions with single words or short phrases.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can ask for help when needed.
I can indicate a need for help by raising hand, hitting switch, etc.
I can indicate yes/no when asked, “Do you understand?” or “Do you have any questions?”
I can indicate a need for assistance through gestures, eye contact or gaze, vocalizations, etc.
I can use voice or a multiple message communication system, ask a question for clarification or more information (e.g., “Why?,” “What’s that?,” “Who did that?,” “Where is it?”).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, ask for help when needed.
I can indicate yes/no when asked, “Do you need help?”
I can when prompted, uses appropriate gestures, eye contact or gaze, vocalizations, etc. to ask for help.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can indicate distress.
I can cry, gesture, or vocalize to indicate distress.
I can activate an audio “Help” switch.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.3|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.4|K.text: With guidance and support, describe familiar people, places, things, and events.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.4|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, identify familiar people, places, things, and events.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently describe familiar people, places, things, and events in detail and using vivid language.
I can use descriptive words and phrases to create a clear picture in the listener's mind.
I can use my descriptions to share my experiences and connect with others
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can describe familiar people, places, things, and events using complete sentences and relevant details.
 I can use descriptive language to share my observations and experiences.
 I can answer questions about what I have described.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can describe familiar people, places, things, and events using simple sentences and some details.
 I can use some descriptive words to share my observations and experiences.
 I can answer simple questions about what I have described.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify familiar people, places, things, and events.
 I can use single words or short phrases to describe them.
 I can answer basic questions about what I have described.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, identify familiar people, places, things, and events.
I can identify a specific person by pointing or naming when asked (e.g., “Who is your teacher?”).
I can identify the name of objects from choices (e.g., “Is this a pencil or a crayon?”).
I can name activity or point to correct icon on schedule when asked, “What’s next?”
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, respond to familiar people and things.
I can respond to familiar people when they are in front of the student (e.g., “Billie, look at this teacher.”).
I can respond to familiar objects when placed in front of the student (e.g., “Tom, where is your book?”).
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, attend to familiar people and things.
I can with guidance and support, look at or face person speaking to them.
I can with guidance and support, locate own cubby/schedule.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.4|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.5|K.text: With guidance and support, create an original or utilize existing visual displays to support descriptions.
WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.5|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, add or select drawings or other visual or tactile displays that relate to familiar people, places, things, and events.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can create detailed and creative visual displays that effectively support my descriptions.
I can use a variety of visual elements (e.g., symbols, colors, textures) to add meaning and interest to my descriptions.
I can explain how my visual display helps others understand my descriptions.
I can use visual displays to present information to others in a clear and engaging way
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can create my own simple visual displays (e.g., drawings, diagrams) to support my descriptions.
I can use existing visual displays (e.g., pictures, charts) to enhance my descriptions.
I can explain how the visual elements in my display connect to my descriptions
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can describe the main objects or characters in a picture or image.
With some support, I can use a picture or image to help me retell a simple story.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify basic visual elements in a picture or image.
With significant support, I can attempt to connect a picture or image to a simple story or description.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, add or select drawings or other visual or tactile displays that relate to familiar people, places, things, and events.
I can given a topic, such as birthday, add a drawing or picture to provide additional detail.
I can with guidance and support, identify drawings or other visual or tactile displays that relate to familiar people, places, things, and events.
I can with guidance and support, identify familiar people through gestures, eye contact or gaze, vocalizations, etc.
I can with guidance and support, identify a photo, drawing, or object about a classroom event.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, add or select drawings or other visual or tactile displays that relate to familiar people, places, things, and events given an array of objects to choose from.
I can with guidance and support, attend to familiar people through gestures, eye contact or gaze, vocalizations, etc.
I can given the topic of “kitchen” and four household objects, select the kitchen utensil (e.g., not hairbrush, light bulb, or shoe).
I can with guidance and support, select a photo, drawing, or object that relates to a classroom event.
I can given four objects, select the object that represents a familiar person, place, thing or event.
I can after hearing the teacher talk about today’s weather, place correct weather picture on a weather graph.
I can given a topic, such as farm, the student will identify which of the two pictures relates to a farm.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, attend to objects placed before them.
I can vocalize, gesture, or eye gaze to indicate attention to an object related to a specific topic.
I can reach for an object that is related to an activity when placed in front of them.

WI-CC-ELA|SL.K.5|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.1.a|K.text: Demonstrate an understanding of how language functions in different cultures and contexts; apply this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening, and make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking. a. Recognize and appreciate the linguistic diversity of peers, teachers, and other members of the school community.
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.1.a|K.ee_text: Use language to achieve desired outcomes when communicating. b. Notice linguistic diversity.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can celebrate the linguistic diversity of my school community.
I can use my knowledge of different languages and cultures to connect with others.
I can create presentations or projects that showcase the linguistic diversity of my community.
I can advocate for the importance of language diversity and inclusion.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can recognize and appreciate the linguistic diversity of my school community.
I can understand how language functions in different cultures and contexts.
I can use this knowledge to comprehend more fully when reading and listening.
I can make effective choices when composing, creating, and speaking.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can appreciate the different languages spoken by my classmates and teachers.
I can identify how language can be used to express different emotions and ideas.
I can use simple greetings in different languages.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify different languages spoken by people around me.
I can recognize that people use different words and expressions depending on where they come from.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, distinguish between letters and other symbols or shapes.
I can point to a display of letters in the classroom when asked to show me the letters (e.g., alphabet on wall, letter blocks, and letter pictures made by students).
I can point to text when asked to show me the words to read in a book.
I can when given a mix of cards with letters and other symbols or shapes printed on them, sort cards into two categories - letters and non-letters.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, demonstrate awareness that letters and words are connected to environmental icons.
I can identify words used in familiar icons (e.g., point to “girls” or “boys” on the bathroom door).
I can point to “stop” on the crosswalk sign.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, communicate awareness that objects, pictures, and signs can represent words and ideas.
I can when instructor forms the sign for “bus” in the student’s hands or with their own hands, indicate awareness by looking toward the door or their backpack.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.1.a|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can share words from my home language and learn words from my classmates' languages.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can recognize and appreciate that people in my school speak different languages.
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can name one language other than English that someone in my class speaks with support.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can notice that some people say words differently with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can, with support, notice that people around me use different languages.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.1.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.2.a|K.text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases in grade-level reading and content; use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consul general and specialized reference materials, and apply word solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate. a. Begin to recognize some words have multiple meanings (e.g., duck, tie).
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.2.a|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging knowledge of word meanings. a. With guidance and support, demonstrate understanding of words used in every day routines.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use my knowledge of vocabulary to understand and explain complex texts.
 I can use my vocabulary skills to communicate effectively in different situations, such as writing, speaking, and listening.
 I can use a variety of resources to learn new vocabulary words and improve my understanding of existing words.
 I can explain the meaning of words to others and help them understand complex texts.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can determine the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases in grade-level reading and content.
 I use context clues, analyze meaningful word parts, consult general and specialized reference materials, and apply word-solving strategies (for meaning) as appropriate.
 I can recognize that some words have multiple meanings (e.g., duck, tie).
 I can use common prefixes and suffixes as clues to the meaning of unknown words (e.g., un-, -ed).
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify when a word has multiple meanings and can usually choose the correct meaning based on the context.
 I can use some common prefixes and suffixes to help me figure out the meaning of unknown words.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can sometimes identify when a word has multiple meanings, but I need help figuring out which meaning is correct.
 I can sometimes use picture clues to help me figure out the meaning of an unknown word.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can demonstrateEE Emerging understandings of writing.
I can when asked to write, select an appropriate writing tool.
I can make letter-like marks on a page that are produced left-to-right or top-to-bottom on a page.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, participates in emergent writing.
I can with guidance and support, select an appropriate writing tool when asked to write.
I can with guidance and support, make marks on the page or selects keys on the keyboard when asked to write.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, explore writing tools.
I can work with teacher to try system/device.
I can show interest in system/device/writing tool by repeatedly activating a switch, banging on a keyboard, handling a marker, grabbing a crayon, etc.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.2.a|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can explain two meanings of a word like duck or tie and use each in a sentence.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can recognize that some words have more than one meaning (duck, tie).
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can match a multiple-meaning word to two pictures with support.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can point to a picture that matches a word I hear with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can, with support, show I understand words used in everyday routines, such as line up or lunch.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.2.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.2.b|K.text: Use some word prefixes and suffixes as clues to the meaning of unknown words (e.g., un-, -ed).

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use un- and -ed to work out new words and tell what they mean.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can use some prefixes and suffixes, like un- and -ed, as clues to what a word means.
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can notice un- or -ed at the start or end of a word with help.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can listen to a word and its un- partner (happy, unhappy) and point to the matching picture with help.
descriptors.ee_at_target: Not applicable

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.2.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.a|K.text: Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings. I can with guidance and support from adults: a. Ask and answer questions about unknown words.
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.a|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of word relationships. a. With guidance and support, ask questions about unknown words.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently ask and answer questions about the meaning of unfamiliar words, using context clues and my own knowledge.
 I can identify and explain similes, metaphors, and other figures of speech with minimal support from adults.
 I can use figurative language in my own writing and speaking to create vivid descriptions and enhance my communication.
 I can recognize and explain the different shades of meaning that words can have, depending on the context.
 I can use my understanding of word relationships and nuances in meaning to interpret texts and solve problems.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can ask and answer questions about the meaning of unfamiliar words with support from adults.
 I can identify and point to pictures that represent the meaning of words with multiple meanings.
 I can begin to identify and explain simple similes and metaphors with support from adults.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can, with some support from adults, ask simple questions about the meaning of unfamiliar words.
 I can, with some support from adults, identify and point to pictures that represent the meaning of words with multiple meanings.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can, with significant support from adults, identify and point to pictures that represent the meaning of simple words.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify unknown words in a text independently.
I can ask a variety of questions about unknown words, such as "What does 'happy' mean?", "Can you give me an example of a happy person?", or "What is the opposite of happy?".
I can use context clues and my knowledge of word parts to figure out the meaning of an unknown word.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify unknown words in a text with minimal support from a teacher or aide.
I can ask a more specific question about an unknown word, such as "What does 'happy' mean in this sentence?"
I can use context clues to guess the meaning of an unknown word.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify unknown words in a text with support from a teacher or aide.
I can ask a simple question about an unknown word, such as "What does that mean?"

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.b|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, sort common objects into familiar categories.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can sort a variety of objects into complex categories based on multiple attributes and relationships.
 I can create my own categories for sorting objects and explain the rationale behind them.
 I can use my sorting skills to organize and classify objects in real-life situations, such as sorting laundry, organizing toys, or arranging books on a shelf.
 I can explain the benefits of sorting and how it helps us be more efficient and organized.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can sort common objects into at least three categories based on different attributes, like color, size, shape, function, or material.
 I can explain my sorting criteria and how different objects fit into each category.
 I can identify objects that don't belong in any of the categories and explain why.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can consistently sort objects into two categories based on one attribute, like shape or function.
 I can explain why certain objects belong in a particular group.
 I can identify objects that don't belong in a group and explain why.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can group some objects together based on a single feature, like color or size.
 I can sometimes identify objects that don't belong in a group.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can sort common objects into familiar categories with minimal guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can sort common objects into familiar categories with some guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I can begin to sort common objects into familiar categories with significant guidance and support.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.c|K.text: Demonstrate understanding of frequently occurring verbs and their opposites (antonyms).
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.c|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, demonstrate understanding of frequently occurring opposites.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can identify and use a variety of verbs, including irregular verbs and phrasal verbs.
I can use antonyms creatively in my writing and speaking to add nuance and meaning.
I can explain how antonyms are used in different contexts, such as jokes, riddles, and figurative language.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify all frequently occurring verbs in simple sentences.
I can consistently match verbs with their antonyms, even for less common verbs.
I can use antonyms to change the meaning of a sentence and understand the impact of this change
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify most familiar verbs in simple sentences.
I can often match verbs with their antonyms, especially for common verbs like "go" and "stop."
I am starting to understand how antonyms can change the meaning of a sentence.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify some familiar verbs in simple sentences.
I can sometimes guess the meaning of a verb based on the context.
I am still learning about antonyms and how they relate to verbs.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can identify and name frequently occurring opposites (e.g., big/small, hot/cold, happy/sad) with 80% accuracy when presented with visual or auditory cues.
I can use frequently occurring opposites in simple sentences and conversations with 70% accuracy.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can identify and name some frequently occurring opposites (e.g., big/small, happy/sad) with 50% accuracy when presented with visual or auditory cues.
I can attempt to use frequently occurring opposites in simple sentences and conversations with 40% accuracy.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can identify and name a few frequently occurring opposites (e.g., big/small) with 30% accuracy when presented with significant support and visual or auditory cues.
I can begin to use frequently occurring opposites (e.g., big/small) in simple phrases with 20% accuracy when prompted and supported.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.c|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.d|K.text: Connect common words to real life (e.g., colorful).
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.d|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, use words to communicate in real-life situations.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can not only identify and connect common words to real-life examples, but I can also use them creatively to describe my own experiences and observations. For example, I might write a story about a colorful dream or draw a picture of a colorful place I'd like to visit.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can identify and connect common words to real-life examples, such as describing a colorful picture with words like "bright," "red," and "yellow."
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can identify many common words and can connect some of them to real-life examples with support.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can identify some common words, but I need help connecting them to real-life examples.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can use words to communicate my needs and wants in familiar situations with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can use single words or short phrases to communicate basic needs and wants with some guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I can use gestures or vocalizations to communicate basic needs and wants with significant guidance and support.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.d|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.e|K.text: Act out shades of meanings with verbs (e.g., strut, skip).
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.e|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, demonstrate an understanding of common verbs.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can creatively use verbs with different shades of meaning to paint vivid pictures with my words and actions.
I can explain the subtle differences between similar verbs and use them effectively in my writing and speaking.
I can use my understanding of verb shades of meaning to enhance my communication and understanding of others.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify and name a wide range of actions, including those with subtle differences in meaning (e.g., tiptoe, creep, slink).
 I can consistently act out actions with accuracy and clarity, using the most appropriate verb.
 I can readily identify and act out shades of meaning between similar verbs, demonstrating a clear understanding of their nuances (e.g., strutting conveys arrogance, skipping conveys joy).
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify and name a variety of actions, including those with similar meanings (e.g., walk, stroll, saunter).
 I can act out most actions with clarity, using appropriate verbs.
 I can sometimes identify and act out shades of meaning between similar verbs (e.g., strut vs. walk).
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can identify and name basic actions (e.g., walk, run, jump).
 I can attempt to act out some actions, but may not always choose the most appropriate verb.
descriptors.ee_at_target: I can identify and use common verbs with guidance and support.
descriptors.ee_approaching: I can identify some common verbs with support.
descriptors.ee_emerging: I am beginning to identify common verbs with significant support.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.3.e|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.4|K.text: Demonstrate an ability to collaboratively and independently build vocabulary knowledge when encountering unknown words including cultural, general academic, and discipline-specific terms and phrases; use vocabulary appropriate to the context and situation.
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.4|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, use words acquired through conversations, being read to, and during shared reading activities.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can independently use context clues and other strategies to figure out the meaning of even complex unfamiliar words.
 I can use precise and varied vocabulary in my own speech and writing, demonstrating a strong command of the language.
 I can actively contribute to group discussions and activities aimed at building vocabulary knowledge.
 I can apply my vocabulary knowledge to real-life situations, such as explaining new concepts to others or participating in discussions about complex topics.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use context clues to figure out the meaning of most unfamiliar words, including cultural, general academic, and discipline-specific terms and phrases.
 I can use new vocabulary words correctly in my own speech and writing, adapting my vocabulary to the context and situation.
 I can work with others to build our shared vocabulary knowledge.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use context clues to figure out the meaning of many unfamiliar words.
 I can ask for help understanding new words and use the explanation to try using the word myself.
 I can use some new vocabulary words in my own speech and writing.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can try to use context clues to figure out the meaning of some unfamiliar words.
 I can sometimes ask for help understanding new words.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can demonstrate an understanding of familiar words.
I can point to their name when the teacher says it.
I can say my name when shown it in writing.
I can during a scavenger hunt activity, student finds items named by the teacher.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, demonstrate an understanding of familiar words.
I can find an object when shown a picture and told the name of the object.
I can select the picture that depicts an object that an adult has verbally labeled.
I can work with peers to find items read off a list by the adult during a scavenger hunt activity.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, responds to personally relevant, familiar words presented as a pictures, signs, or spoken words.
I can exhibit differential affect, vocalization, gaze, or movement to indicate an understanding of vocabulary word (e.g., student gets excited when teacher says, “Look, Mom is here.”).
I can smile broadly when shown a picture symbol reflecting swimming and told, “Swimming. Today, we go swimming.” when it is known that swimming is a favored activity.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.4|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.a|K.text: Demonstrate contextually appropriate use of the conventions of standardized English grammar and usage when writing or speaking. Discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English. Appropriately use and explain the intended purpose of language choice with: a. frequently used nouns, verbs, and prepositions;
WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.a|K.ee_text: Demonstrate emerging understanding of letter and word use. a. With guidance and support, distinguish between letters and other symbols or shapes.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use sophisticated vocabulary and complex sentence structures in my writing and speaking.
 I can adapt my language to different audiences and purposes.
 I can analyze the effects of my language choices on others.
 I can use my knowledge of language to persuade, inform, and entertain others.
 I can use frequently used nouns, verbs, and prepositions in creative and innovative ways.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can use standardized English grammar and usage correctly and consistently in my writing and speaking.
 I can discern when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English.
 I can explain the intended purpose of my language choices clearly and effectively.
 I can use frequently used nouns, verbs, and prepositions correctly and appropriately.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can use a variety of nouns, verbs, and prepositions correctly in sentences.
 I can identify when and where it is appropriate to use standardized English.
 I can explain the intended purpose of my language choices in simple terms.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can use some nouns, verbs, and prepositions in simple sentences.
 I can sometimes identify when I am speaking or writing in a way that is not appropriate for the situation.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support sort common objects into familiar categories.
I can sort like objects into two categories (e.g., sort paper and pencils, shoes and socks).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, matches a common object with another common object that is not an exact match.
I can match one shoe with another shoe from a different pair.
I can match food item to food item.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can demonstrate an understanding of the concept of sameness by matching two objects that are an exact match.
I can with guidance and support from a teacher who holds up one shoe and moves it next to the choices in the array, the student is able to touch the shoe that is the same.
I can with guidance and support from the teacher who helps students identify the features of a familiar object, the student finds the same object from an array and puts the two together.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.a|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can use nouns, verbs and prepositions correctly in longer spoken sentences.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can use frequently used nouns, verbs and prepositions when I speak.
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can name objects and actions in a picture with support.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can point to the object or action an adult names with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can, with support, tell letters apart from other symbols or shapes.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.a|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.b|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, use frequently occurring nouns in communication.

descriptors.cc_advanced: I can use oral pluralizations of nouns in my everyday speech and writing, and I can explain the rules for forming plurals of nouns to others.
descriptors.cc_at_target: I can correctly use oral pluralizations of nouns, including irregular plurals like "feet" and "children."
descriptors.cc_approaching: I can consistently add "-s" to the end of most words to make them plural.
descriptors.cc_emerging: I can sometimes add "-s" to the end of some words to make them plural.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, demonstrate understanding of frequently occurring opposites.
I can indicate preferences by using opposites (e.g., “like” and “don't like”).
I can indicate “want” and “don’t want” when given choices.
I can reply appropriately with “yes” and “no” when given choices.
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, recognize differences by finding the different object in a set of similar objects.
I can remove the ball from a pile of bats on the playground.
I can select the milk carton from a group of juice bottles in the cafeteria.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, communicate an awareness of the concept of difference by attending to new object/stimuli longer than a known stimuli/object.
I can exhibit differential affect, vocalization, gaze, or movement to indicate awareness that an object/stimuli is new or different.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.b|K.descriptor_flag: School descriptor may not match this standard

descriptors_suggested.cc_advanced: I can say plural nouns correctly, including some irregular ones like mice and feet.
descriptors_suggested.cc_at_target: I can say plural nouns correctly by adding -s or -es (dog, dogs; wish, wishes).
descriptors_suggested.cc_approaching: I can say the plural of a familiar noun when an adult models it.
descriptors_suggested.cc_emerging: I can show one or many objects when asked with help.
descriptors_suggested.ee_at_target: I can, with support, use frequently occurring nouns when I communicate.

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.b|K.source: Awsaj EE ELA New Standards 2025 V1 Complete (school sheet, K-5)

WI-CC-ELA|L.K.5.c|K.ee_text: With guidance and support, use frequently occurring plural nouns.

descriptors.cc_advanced:
I can use question words creatively in my writing and speaking.
 I can use question words to analyze and interpret information.
 I can use question words to solve problems and make decisions.
 I can explain the different functions of question words in different contexts.
descriptors.cc_at_target:
I can identify all question words when they are spoken aloud.
 I can use all question words correctly in sentences.
 I can answer questions that begin with a question word, even if the questions are complex.
 I can use question words to ask my own questions about the world around me.
descriptors.cc_approaching:
I can identify most question words when they are spoken aloud.
 I can use most question words correctly in simple sentences.
 I can answer simple questions that begin with a question word.
descriptors.cc_emerging:
I can sometimes identify a question word when it is spoken aloud.
 I can sometimes use a question word in a simple sentence.
descriptors.ee_at_target:
I can with guidance and support, use words to communicate in real-life situations.
I can ask for a desired object by naming it.
I can when shown a picture of the lunchroom, recognize that it is time to go to lunch.
I can call a friend or teacher by name using words, sign, or a communication overlay.
I can when asked if something is wrong, respond (e.g., “yes,” “no,” or “help”).
descriptors.ee_approaching:
I can with guidance and support, identify real-life connections with words and their uses.
I can look at a familiar object when named.
I can look at a familiar person when named.
descriptors.ee_emerging:
I can with guidance and support, communicate in school-based settings and receive a response from staff and/or students.
I can with guidance and support, exhibit differential affect, vocalization, gaze, or movement when addressed by the teacher.
